documents.title: Report of the Agent General of UNKRA, A/2222: organization and work to 15 September 1952
documents.document_number: A/2222; Official Records Seventh Session Supplement 19
documents.provenance_family: United Nations original General Assembly report (Bank of Korea data reused where specified)
documents.summary: Limited UNKRA pre-armistice projects; 1950-06 to 1952-06 Busan retail price index 19-fold; rice 5380 won per mal June 1950, 124030 won June 1952, 150000 won Aug 1952; historical ECA pre-engineering fertilizer plant before June 1950, not 1952 Samchok completion
documents.source_quality_note: PDF extracted text contains OCR artifacts, especially tables; prose paragraphs cross-checked, original scan pages not independently visually inspected

documents.title: UNKRA A/2222 Addenda 1 and 2: 24 Nov 1952 $70m programme and relief progress to 15 Feb 1953
documents.document_number: A/2222/Add.1 and Add.2; Official Records Seventh Session Supplement 19A
documents.provenance_family: United Nations original General Assembly report
documents.summary: Advisory Committee 24 Nov 1952 approved $70m relief and rehabilitation through 30 June 1953 after consultation with UNC and ROK President; $14m essential imports including fertilizer; $6m grain and $3m fertilizer imports allocated Dec 1952; 2 grain ships arrived Busan early Feb 1953; no Samchok-specific $17m disbursement shown in text
documents.source_quality_note: OCR occasionally garbles $20,634,000 industry allocation, so not independently confirmed as precise figure

documents.title: UN Archives UNKRA institutional retrospective: founding resolution citation discrepancy
documents.creator_or_sender: UN Archives and Records Management Section
documents.provenance_family: UN later institutional retrospective; not contemporary independent evidence
documents.summary: Institutional web page states founding resolution 401(V), while contemporary UN A/2222 Annex I and UN Digital Library catalogue cite 410(V); retrospective error likely. The page says 1953 full operation, but A/2222 describes limited 1952 work; different operational scope.
